blocks.text: SOFIA, Bulgaria—Eleven people are missing after two merchant ships were struck off the Bulgarian coast on Tuesday in the latest spillover from the Ukraine war in the Black Sea. Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev summoned the Russian ambassador after drones struck a Ukrainian-owned cargo ship. Another vessel was also hit and sank further north off the coast of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and European Union (EU) member. NATO chief Mark Rutte said the alliance would adjust its defenses “as needed.” Radev said the Ukrainian-owned cargo ship Chelsea 3 was “hit by three aerial drones,” and shortly afterwards, another ship was “struck” and […]...
